name: Cherelle Inspired by Dior Oud Ispahan | Luxury Unisex Perfume
description: Cherelle, inspired by the luxurious Dior Oud Ispahan, is a deep, sophisticated unisex fragrance crafted for lovers of rich oriental scents. It opens with an elegant blend of warm floral and slightly spicy notes, immediately setting the tone for a premium Arabian-style experience. As it develops, a bold heart of rose and oud emerges—smooth, smoky, and irresistibly captivating. The base completes the scent with patchouli, labdanum, and amber nuances, creating a long-lasting, sensual aroma that lingers beautifully on the skin. Crafted with a high perfume-oil concentration, Cherelle ensures excellent longevity and projection, making it perfect for evenings, winter seasons, and formal events. Mysterious, bold, and refined, this fragrance delivers the iconic Oud Ispahan feel at an exceptional value—exclusively from Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Floral Notes, Soft Spice Accords Heart Notes: Oud, Rose Base Notes: Patchouli, Labdanum, Amber Longevity: 10–12 hours (Very Long-Lasting) Occasion: Ideal for evenings, winter wear, and formal events Why Choose Cherelle?
